note: Weblate service accounts that are AI translators or reviewers (ADR-0160 §1, §4, §10). Each account is tied to one named model. The bundle export uses this to enforce 'an AI-written string needs a reviewer on a different model, or a human': an approval where author and approver are both AI on the same model, or either is a Weblate bot account not listed here, is omitted. Nothing here grants access; Weblate does. Filled in by ut-docs#4366, under CODEOWNERS.
